outcome: Dose d4 attempt 1: FAILED after the search finished (formal measurement begun), not by the science. A_contract, V_retire (d1 91 states 273.0 GB, d2 88 states 265.8 GB, each dose's distinct Top-4 kept), B_rebuild (d1 Top-2..4, 3571 s) and X_export_prior (d1+d2 Top-4 to the relay, verified by hub sha256, manifest 9068d6f8) all OK. The search ran 07:00Z-18:33Z and its driver printed SEARCH_DONE; the final push to network volume ugllmlv19t (300 GB, EUR-IS-1) then failed with OSError 122 'Disk quota exceeded' (last good mirror pass 18:32:23Z), the driver's next volume write raised and it marked RUN_FAILED at 18:34:31Z. Root cause: no capacity check -- d4's ~92 states (~3 GB each with pruned weights) beside the 8 retained d1/d2 Top-4 states and both recovered students exceed 300 GB. The pod stopped answering ssh at about 18:37Z (provider uptime 0, cause not determined), collection failed (manifest rc=255) and the launcher deleted it at 18:41:53Z. Durable: the search journal and states on the volume as of the 18:32:23Z pass. Next: free room (the relayed d1/d2 finalists), add a room check and fail a search whose final push fails, then resume the SAME dose from the volume journal (preregistered retry_policy).
